requirements.text: Create a user-friendly experience for students and staff
Students must be able to handle loans, renewals, and room bookings online
Automate the handling of fines and overdue items
Provide librarians with tools for managing inventory and generating reports
Integrate the library management system with the university's student record system
Migrate existing data without losing any borrowing histories or student accounts
Enable real-time search and availability for loans and renewals
User account page must show current loans, due dates, and outstanding fines
Provide online room booking with options for date, time, and number of users
Send automated email reminders for due dates and fines
The platform must be mobile-friendly
Librarians must have an intuitive interface for adding, updating, and retiring items in the catalogue
Generate comprehensive reports on loan volumes and trends
Provide insights into room utilization for better understanding of student needs
Track fine revenue to evaluate the effectiveness of policies
Allow librarians to place holds or restrictions on student accounts with outstanding fines
Verify students’ enrollment status for borrowing and room bookings
Access basic student information (names, IDs, contact details) for library accounts
Collaborate with the IT department to address technical challenges related to legacy systems
Ensure budget constraints are considered in feature prioritization
Establish a realistic timeline for implementation that allows for testing and training
Provide adequate training for librarians and support staff on the new system
Plan for ongoing support and maintenance post-launch
